flowchart TD
    subgraph User_Lane["User（Business User / IT Admin）"]
        Start(("登入 ERP 進入工具"))
        DecideListAccess{"已有 Token 嗎？"}
        ClickCreate["點擊「+ 建立 Token」"]
        InputDesc["輸入描述<br/>(1..100 字元)"]
        SubmitForm["點擊「建立」"]
        SeeRevealed["看到一次性 Token<br/>(P03)"]
        CopyToken["點擊複製按鈕"]
        ConfirmCopied["勾選「我已複製」"]
        CloseReveal["關閉 P03"]
        ViewN8nGuide["查看 N8N 指南"]
        UseInN8N["在 N8N 設定<br/>Authorization Header"]
        WantRevoke{"需要撤銷？"}
        ClickRevokeRow["點擊行末「撤銷」"]
        ConfirmRevoke["在 P04 Dialog 確認"]
        DoneFlow(("完成"))
    end

    subgraph Client_Lane["Client App（Razor + Alpine.js）"]
        ListPage["P01 Token 列表載入"]
        OpenModal["P02 Modal 開啟"]
        Validate{"Validation：1..100 字元 ?"}
        ShowInlineError["P02 Inline Error<br/>+ shake animation"]
        FetchPost["fetch POST /api/v1/me/tokens<br/>X-CSRF + Idempotency-Key"]
        ShowResp{"Response 201?"}
        WriteTempData["寫 TempData(rawToken)"]
        RedirectP03["redirect → /ApiTokens/Created"]
        InvokeClipboard["navigator.clipboard.writeText"]
        ShowToast["dispatch Toast(success)"]
        OpenRevokeDialog["P04 Dialog 開啟"]
        FetchDelete["fetch DELETE /api/v1/me/tokens/{tokenId}"]
        UpdateBadge["Badge: Active → Revoked"]
    end

    subgraph Server_Lane["Server（ASP.NET Core 8）"]
        AuthCheck{"Cookie + CSRF<br/>有效?"}
        Reject401(("401 Unauthorized<br/>→ /Login"))
        SrvValidate{"FluentValidation<br/>+ 50 Token 上限?"}
        SrvCreate["TokenGenerationService.Generate<br/>+ INSERT api_tokens<br/>+ INSERT token_audit_logs"]
        SrvRevoke["UPDATE api_tokens SET status='revoked'<br/>+ INSERT token_audit_logs"]
        SrvFail422(("422 Unprocessable<br/>{ error: DESCRIPTION_INVALID }"))
        SrvFail429(("429 Too Many<br/>{ error: TOKEN_LIMIT_EXCEEDED }"))
        SrvSuccess201(("201 Created<br/>{ rawToken, prefix, ... }"))
        SrvSuccess200(("200 OK { revokedAt }"))
    end

    Start --> ListPage
    ListPage --> DecideListAccess
    DecideListAccess -->|"否（空狀態）"| ClickCreate
    DecideListAccess -->|"是"| WantRevoke
    ClickCreate --> OpenModal
    OpenModal --> InputDesc
    InputDesc --> Validate
    Validate -->|"否（空 / >100）"| ShowInlineError
    ShowInlineError --> InputDesc
    Validate -->|"是"| SubmitForm
    SubmitForm --> FetchPost
    FetchPost --> AuthCheck
    AuthCheck -->|"否"| Reject401
    AuthCheck -->|"是"| SrvValidate
    SrvValidate -->|"描述無效"| SrvFail422
    SrvFail422 --> ShowInlineError
    SrvValidate -->|"超過 50 個"| SrvFail429
    SrvFail429 --> ShowInlineError
    SrvValidate -->|"通過"| SrvCreate

    SrvCreate -.->|"fork: 同 TX"| WriteAuditEvent["IAuditLogRepository.AddAsync"]
    SrvCreate -.->|"fork: 同 TX"| InsertToken["INSERT INTO api_tokens"]
    WriteAuditEvent --> JoinTx["Commit TX"]
    InsertToken --> JoinTx
    JoinTx --> SrvSuccess201

    SrvSuccess201 --> ShowResp
    ShowResp -->|"是 201"| WriteTempData
    WriteTempData --> RedirectP03
    RedirectP03 --> SeeRevealed
    SeeRevealed --> CopyToken
    CopyToken --> InvokeClipboard
    InvokeClipboard --> ShowToast
    ShowToast --> ConfirmCopied
    ConfirmCopied --> CloseReveal
    CloseReveal --> ViewN8nGuide
    ViewN8nGuide --> UseInN8N
    UseInN8N --> WantRevoke
    WantRevoke -->|"否（仍在使用）"| DoneFlow
    WantRevoke -->|"是"| ClickRevokeRow
    ClickRevokeRow --> OpenRevokeDialog
    OpenRevokeDialog --> ConfirmRevoke
    ConfirmRevoke --> FetchDelete
    FetchDelete --> AuthCheck
    SrvRevoke --> SrvSuccess200
    SrvSuccess200 --> UpdateBadge
    UpdateBadge --> DoneFlow

    classDef user fill:#fff3cd,stroke:#ffc107,color:#000
    classDef client fill:#cfe2ff,stroke:#0d6efd,color:#000
    classDef server fill:#d1e7dd,stroke:#198754,color:#000
    classDef error fill:#f8d7da,stroke:#dc3545,color:#000

    class Start,DecideListAccess,ClickCreate,InputDesc,SubmitForm,SeeRevealed,CopyToken,ConfirmCopied,CloseReveal,ViewN8nGuide,UseInN8N,WantRevoke,ClickRevokeRow,ConfirmRevoke,DoneFlow user
    class ListPage,OpenModal,Validate,ShowInlineError,FetchPost,ShowResp,WriteTempData,RedirectP03,InvokeClipboard,ShowToast,OpenRevokeDialog,FetchDelete,UpdateBadge client
    class AuthCheck,SrvValidate,SrvCreate,SrvRevoke,SrvSuccess201,SrvSuccess200,WriteAuditEvent,InsertToken,JoinTx server
    class Reject401,SrvFail422,SrvFail429 error
